mentions.name: Dodolr
mentions.description: A minimalist and calm work/task tracking app that supports tasks (called dodos), notes, and follow-ups. It deliberately omits notifications and reminders so users remain fully accountable for completing their work by moving tasks to terminal stages. It works well for small 1-3 person teams and is being built for a few local customers, with Early Access open via a request form.
mentions.audience: Solo founders, power users who prefer non-intrusive tools, and small 1-3 person teams
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been working on a minimalist and calm work/task tracking app called Dodolr (doo-doo-lr) which supports tasks (dodos), notes and follow-up since last few months.
